title: Coordination-Aware Shared Control for Bimanual Dexterous Teleoperation
presentation: Poster · IROS Workshop: Toward Human-Level Robotic Teammates, 2026
summary: A coordination-aware shared control framework that recognizes bimanual coordination patterns and adapts robot assistance during dexterous teleoperation. A 16-participant user study showed reduced operator workload.

title: Measuring and Steering Motion Legibility in Generalist Robot Policies
status: In submission · IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: Measuring and steering motion legibility in vision-language-action policies, using classifier-free guidance to generate more legible behaviors while preserving task success.

title: Beyond Task Success: User Interactions with and Perceptions of Hierarchical VLA-Driven Robots
status: In submission · ACM/IEEE International Conference on Human-Robot Interaction (HRI), 2027
summary: Studying user interactions with and perceptions of robots driven by hierarchical vision-language-action policies.
